package lib

// Parser deliberately mirrors yaml.v3's parser type which has a
// pointer-receiver method NAMED `init`. The piko compiler used to
// gate package-level init() detection on the function name alone,
// so this method was added to initFunctionIndices and invoked by
// Service.ExecuteInits at startup with no receiver - derailing every
// subsequent pointer-receiver call that depended on the receiver
// being a valid *Parser.
type Parser struct {
	Value string
	Ready bool
}

// init is a METHOD on *Parser, NOT the package init function.
// (The package has no top-level `func init()`.)
func (p *Parser) init() {
	if p.Ready {
		return
	}
	p.Ready = true
}

// Prepare is the caller-visible entry point. It calls the receiver's
// init() method internally, exercising the exact dispatch shape
// (pointer receiver method whose name is "init") that yaml.v3's
// parser.init/parser.expect rely on.
func (p *Parser) Prepare() {
	p.init()
}
